A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Render-of-Thought study and contain 18 complete pages, including Appendices A-H. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support comparison of all equations, tables, figures and appendix material.

before.justification: v3 reports original RoT benchmark results, inference timings, ablations and training-cost measurements, including GPQA and ProsQA evaluations in Appendix F.

after.justification: v4 retains original mathematical, logical and scientific reasoning evaluations, together with ablations, timing measurements and case studies in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical CoT rendering, visual projection, two-stage alignment and LoRA training, losses, and dynamic or fixed-budget decoding procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GSM8k-Aug, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, MultiArith and MATH, plus GPQA and ProsQA in Appendix F. Training coverage and out-of-distribution scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: SFT variants, iCoT, Coconut, CODI and CoLaR variants retain their respective comparison roles in Tables 1-3 and 8-9 and Figure 4. The new Deng citation does not introduce an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same model configurations, sample counts, splits, metrics, training budgets and decoding settings. Timing procedures and appendix evaluation protocols also match.

E4.justification: Training-stage, rendering, projection-head and token-budget ablations are unchanged. The robustness evaluations, unified-backbone control and latent-token success/failure case studies also remain identical.

E5.justification: Both versions state five random seeds and reporting of means with 95% confidence intervals in Section 4.1. Appendix A's seed-0 training statement and all uncertainty-reporting practices remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative case outcomes match. For example, Table 9 retains RoT's Pass@1 scores of 60.5 on GPQA and 100.0 on ProsQA.

T1.justification: Section 3's mathematical definitions and Equations (1)-(4) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theoretical results or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: visually grounded latent reasoning, plug-and-play use of pretrained vision encoders, and 3-4× token compression with inference acceleration.

C2.justification: Interpretations of visual alignment, generalization, latent-token saturation and termination failure are unchanged. Limitations concerning domain/language coverage, token-budget calibration and training overhead are also retained.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A and D retain identical hyperparameters, hardware, token initialization and training-time information. The homepage, code and model access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction replaces Liu et al. (2025) with Deng et al. (2025) among works associated with architectural complexity and training instability. v4 adds Deng et al.'s 'Latent Reasoning in LLMs as a Vocabulary-Space Superposition' reference. Liu et al.'s Marcos work remains cited in Section 2 and listed in the bibliography.

P1.justification: Textual edits are limited to the citation/reference update and arXiv version/date stamp. The narrative prose, terminology, section organization and appendix structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added reference reflows bibliography columns across pages 10-11, while the introductory citation changes line wrapping on pages 1-2. All figures, tables, captions and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision substitutes one introductory citation and adds its bibliography entry, accompanied by minor reflow. Methods, empirical evidence, analyses, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices. These limited reference and presentation edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
